items.title: Apple, Microsoft hit all-time highs as Nasdaq surges 2% in post-election rally: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks bounced on Wednesday after Democrats' sweeping mid-term elections.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow jumps over 1,000 points, S&P 500 and Nasdaq gain after Democrats win control of Congress
items.summary: Markets priced in a divided government and assessed what a Democratic sweep of midterm elections means for key industries.

items.title: Counterparty Concentration and Depreciation Define CoreWeave Now
items.summary: CoreWeave's GPU empire carries a backlog that Wall Street analysts value at more than double today's share price, yet the same contracts burying rivals in debt may be quietly burying CoreWeave too. One upcoming quarter will decide which side is right.

items.title: Oracle Continues to Crash Lower and Lower But Two Bullish Desks Agree That Its Price WIll More Than Triple
items.summary: Oracle has shed half its value in a year while racking up billions in negative free cash flow, yet two Wall Street desks just slapped $400 price targets on a stock trading at $126. Something has to give.

items.title: Forget the 12-Month Squeeze: Microsoft Is Primed for an Explosive AI Payoff
items.summary: Microsoft's stock barely moved over the past year while its earnings surged, and that widening gap tells a story most investors are misreading entirely.

items.title: Blue Chips Pop On Blue Wave As Dow Surges 1,000 Points
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,009 points, or 1.9%, at Wednesday’s open, according to ABC News. The move came the morning after midterm results showed Democrats taking control of the U.S. House and Senate. ABC News put the S&P 500 and the NASDAQ Composite each up 1.1%. The rally followed a jittery week. The […]

items.title: Apple Soars 6% as Bernstein Lifts Price Target to $380 After Post-Earnings Margin Scare
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple shares jumped 6% today after Bernstein raised its price target to $380 from $370. Microsoft and Amazon rose about as much on no news of their own, pointing to a Big Tech rally.

items.title: Amazon Soars 7% as Tech Shrugs Off Data Center Bans: “Can Buy Its Way Into New Towns”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAmazon jumped 7% today and Microsoft rallied with it, after 10 Ohio towns banned large data centers. Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet can afford to build elsewhere, so local bans won’t slow their AI spending.
